outcomes.name: Operating-system change
outcomes.summary: From 'am I doing enough / what next / keep moving' to 'is this the right thing / what is here / present without manufactured urgency.' Stop treating baseline existence as urgency.

status_rules.on_track: presence trending up over 4 weeks AND internal-question audit shows shift away from urgency framing
status_rules.watching: presence flat or internal questions unchanged for 2+ weeks
status_rules.off_track: presence trending down OR urgency questions still dominate after week 8 of detox

outcomes.name: Break the 3↔4 loop
outcomes.summary: Absolute cessation long enough for the system to learn anxiety resolves without discharge. Cannot be partially broken.

status_rules.off_track: 2+ unplanned instances during detox (Day 90 question 1 threshold)

outcomes.name: Preserve reflective capacity without escape function
outcomes.summary: Protect the value of reflection without letting escape ride along. Reflective capacity migrates to structured journaling during detox.

status_rules.on_track: Habit 2 7-day verification rate ≥ 70% on settled-coded instances; structured journaling producing insights
status_rules.off_track: verification rate < 50% OR no journaling insights for 3+ weeks

outcomes.name: Replace automaticity with conscious interruption
outcomes.summary: Stop using speed and over-execution as identity regulation. Tolerate incompletion, stillness, slack, non-urgency.

status_rules.on_track: weekly work behaviour flag count trending down; end-of-task pause held
status_rules.off_track: flag count trending up OR end-of-task pause regularly skipped

outcomes.name: Lower accumulated stress structurally
outcomes.summary: Habits are downstream of stress accumulation. Test: stress declines structurally, not in tracked-and-suppressed form.

status_rules.on_track: stress scores trending down across months AND holding through known high-load weeks
status_rules.watching: stress flat OR pattern of low weekday / spike Friday
status_rules.off_track: stress trending up OR clear suppression pattern

outcomes.name: Prevent import of consulting cycle into King Size
outcomes.summary: Bounded scope. Slower decision velocity. No demonstration-through-speed.

status_rules.on_track: first-30-days scope held; decision-velocity rule held; questions about 'whether/what' dominate
status_rules.watching: scope creep flagged but contained; questions mixed
status_rules.off_track: scope breach OR same-day significant decisions OR urgency questions return

outcomes.name: Prove change survives real stress
outcomes.summary: September detox + October King Size + December pregnancy timing is the stress test. Change in calm periods is not yet change.

status_rules.on_track: three of four Day 90 markers favourable
status_rules.watching: two of four Day 90 markers favourable
status_rules.off_track: fewer than two favourable; timeline shifts
